title: Honored Autopay Drafts and Your Home-Site Lease Renewal Rate
content:
**Home-Site Lease — autopay record in renewal pricing**

An autopay adjustment, in percentage points, is added to the renewal increase rate of a Home-Site Lease renewal offer. It counts the honored autopay drafts in the trailing 12 calendar months, read on the day the offer is issued.

**Honored autopay drafts** are the payments received on the lease through automatic ACH draft (autopay) in the trailing 12 calendar months, less the returned payments posted on the lease in the same months.

| Honored autopay drafts in the trailing 12 calendar months | Autopay adjustment |
|---|---|
| 11 or more | -0.3 percentage points |
| at least 6 but fewer than 11 | -0.15 percentage points |
| fewer than 6 | zero |

A negative adjustment lowers the renewal increase rate by that many points.

### Questions on the autopay adjustment

*Are portal or office payments counted?* No. Only payments received through automatic ACH draft are counted as drafts.

*How do returned payments enter the count?* Each returned payment posted on the lease in the same 12 months is taken off the number of autopay payments received.

*Where do the rows divide?* At 11 honored drafts (11 gives -0.3, 10 gives -0.15) and at 6 (6 gives -0.15, 5 gives zero).

### Hypothetical records

| Autopay payments received | Returned payments posted | Honored drafts | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | 0 | 12 | -0.3 |
| 12 | 1 | 11 | -0.3 |
| 12 | 2 | 10 | -0.15 |
| 7 | 1 | 6 | -0.15 |
| 6 | 1 | 5 | zero |
